# Karen Shenton-Stone

Karen Shenton-Stone is the current Connétable of [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Karen Shenton-Stone has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-shenton-stone#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Martin unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/karen-stone/)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karen-shenton-stone#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Martin.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/karen-shenton-stone/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wuhBLZ26h_o)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=36)

Karen Shenton-Stone has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/26/constable-stone-hopes-to-roll-into-third-term/)\]

## Election History

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin) (1 seat), 16th May 2018.

**Karen Shenton-Stone was elected as Connétable of St Martin in 2018 unopposed**.
